title: αὐτός: he, she, it; self
subtitle: Let position and article show the function.
overview: αὐτός can work as a third-person pronoun, an intensive (“self”), or an identity adjective (“same”).
Article placement is a valuable clue: αὐτὸς ὁ λόγος and ὁ αὐτὸς λόγος do different jobs.

sections.title: Three common uses
rows: he or she speaks to them
